_README: The 384 leg of the Stage-D consensus+PV head-to-head, added 2026-06-09 (Session 108). The original five Stage-D cells (era1-pv-stage-d-cells.json) re-extracted + re-verified their proposers via a gated API run. The 384 leg needs NO new API spend: the carry-forward adversarial verifier (gemini-3-flash, verify_adversarial-text, T=0.0, minimal, n=1) ALREADY ran over the pv-diag-384 HIGH-text consensus pools in March 2026, and its candidate_manifest.json + probabilities.json are on disk. This cell points run_era1_pv_stage_d.py --score at the matched pool (flash-high-text-16of30, the best-F1 operating point of the N=30 HIGH-text consensus family, matching the 512 cell's N=30 HIGH-text champion consensus_t23=23-of-30) via the verified_pools shape, so the 384 number is produced by the IDENTICAL build+score code that made 256/512. Run with --summary-name stage_d_score_summary_384.json so the existing five-cell summary is not clobbered.
